blocks.text: Auseklis is the morning star and deity of the dawn in latvian mythology. Getting inspired by the snow, the diaspora and sunrises in Riga, a project titled Auseklis is a short story about seeing the stars, dreaming, and re-creating glimpses of myths and legends. “If you find some rocks on Friday in the winter season, they are possibly covered with ancient texts of people who daydreamed… A rabbit lost in the big city carries the messages of meeting the trees of the forest. Auskelis has fled from the noise of the nightmares and is waiting, in the darkness, for a sign to make his appearance in the skyline…”
Residency Project at ISSP, Riga Latvia Digital Photography 2022
